== policy ==
table inet cfab-fwd
delete table inet cfab-fwd
table inet cfab-fwd {
  set admin { type ifname; elements = { "eth9","eth1","eth0" } }
  set storage { type ifname; elements = { "cfab-st","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-fb" } }
  set cluster { type ifname; elements = { "cfab-cl","cfab-cl-bk","cfab-cl-b2","cfab-cl-fb" } }
  set mgmt { type ifname; elements = { "cfab-mg","cfab-mg-bk","cfab-mg-b2","cfab-mg-fb","cfab-gw249" } }
  set cfab { type ifname; elements = { "cfab-cl","cfab-cl-b2","cfab-cl-bk","cfab-cl-fb","cfab-cl-fb-a","cfab-cl-fb-b","cfab-cl-fb-c","cfab-gw249","cfab-gw249-a","cfab-gw249-b","cfab-gw249-c","cfab-id199","cfab-id199-peer","cfab-id249","cfab-id249-peer","cfab-id99","cfab-id99-peer","cfab-mg","cfab-mg-b2","cfab-mg-bk","cfab-mg-fb","cfab-mg-fb-a","cfab-mg-fb-b","cfab-mg-fb-c","cfab-st","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-fb","cfab-st-fb-a","cfab-st-fb-b","cfab-st-fb-c","cfab-work-vms","eth0","eth1","eth9" } }
  set cfab-work-vms-local { type ipv4_addr; }
  chain forward {
    type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
    iifname @admin counter drop comment "admin-in"
    oifname @admin counter drop comment "admin-out"
    iifname != @cfab oifname != @cfab counter accept comment "foreign-transit"
    ct state invalid counter comment "ct-invalid-seen"
    iifname @storage oifname "cfab-work-vms" ip daddr != @cfab-work-vms-local counter comment "stray-vms"
    ct state established,related accept comment "return-of-allowed"
    iifname @storage oifname @storage counter accept comment "allow-storage-storage"
    iifname @cluster oifname @cluster counter accept comment "allow-cluster-cluster"
    iifname @mgmt oifname @mgmt counter accept comment "allow-mgmt-mgmt"
    iifname "cfab-work-vms" oifname @storage counter accept comment "allow-vms-storage"
    iifname @storage oifname "cfab-work-vms" counter accept comment "allow-storage-vms"
    counter comment "default-deny"
  }
}

== mark ==
table inet cfab
delete table inet cfab
table inet cfab {
  chain out {
    type filter hook output priority mangle;
    # ceiling storage: 3 members, 7 LSAs (3 router + 4 network), 2 peers
    #   base = 1 hello + 2x7 flood + ceil(7x2/5) retx = 18 pkt/s; x4 headroom = 72; floor 20 pkt/s (measured burst) x4 = 80
    oifname { "cfab-st-fb" } ip protocol 89 limit rate over 80/second burst 160 packets counter drop comment "ceiling-storage"
    # ceiling cluster: 3 members, 7 LSAs (3 router + 4 network), 2 peers
    #   base = 1 hello + 2x7 flood + ceil(7x2/5) retx = 18 pkt/s; x4 headroom = 72; floor 20 pkt/s (measured burst) x4 = 80
    oifname { "cfab-cl-fb" } ip protocol 89 limit rate over 80/second burst 160 packets counter drop comment "ceiling-cluster"
    # ceiling mgmt: 3 members, 7 LSAs (3 router + 4 network), 2 peers
    #   base = 1 hello + 2x7 flood + ceil(7x2/5) retx = 18 pkt/s; x4 headroom = 72; floor 20 pkt/s (measured burst) x4 = 80
    oifname { "cfab-mg-fb" } ip protocol 89 limit rate over 80/second burst 160 packets counter drop comment "ceiling-mgmt"
    oifname { "cfab-st","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-fb" } ip protocol 89 return comment "guard-storage-ospf"
    oifname { "cfab-st","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-fb" } udp dport 3784 return comment "guard-storage-bfd"
    oifname { "cfab-st","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-fb" } ip dscp set cs0 comment "dscp-storage-bulk"
    oifname { "cfab-cl","cfab-cl-bk","cfab-cl-b2","cfab-cl-fb" } ip protocol 89 return comment "guard-cluster-ospf"
    oifname { "cfab-cl","cfab-cl-bk","cfab-cl-b2","cfab-cl-fb" } udp dport 3784 return comment "guard-cluster-bfd"
    oifname { "cfab-cl","cfab-cl-bk","cfab-cl-b2","cfab-cl-fb" } ip dscp set cs6 comment "dscp-cluster-bulk"
    oifname { "cfab-mg","cfab-mg-bk","cfab-mg-b2","cfab-mg-fb","cfab-gw249" } ip protocol 89 return comment "guard-mgmt-ospf"
    oifname { "cfab-mg","cfab-mg-bk","cfab-mg-b2","cfab-mg-fb","cfab-gw249" } udp dport 3784 return comment "guard-mgmt-bfd"
    oifname { "cfab-mg","cfab-mg-bk","cfab-mg-b2","cfab-mg-fb","cfab-gw249" } ip dscp set cs2 comment "dscp-mgmt-bulk"
  }
  chain forward {
    type filter hook forward priority mangle; policy accept;
    iifname "cfab-work-vms" oifname { "cfab-st","cfab-st-bk","cfab-st-b2","cfab-st-fb" } ip dscp set cs0 comment "dscp-vms-storage"
  }
}
